text.tspan: AWS global infrastructure: region → AZs → data centers, plus edge locations
Region: ap-south-1 (Mumbai) · a cluster of data centers in one geographic area
AZ facts: usually 3 per region (min 3, max 6) · each AZ = one or more discrete data centers
far enough apart to survive a disaster, close enough for fast links · HA = run in ≥ 2 AZs
How to choose a region (4 factors)
1. Compliance: data governance and legal rules
(data may have to stay in a country)
3. Available services: not every service or
REGIONAL (most services): EC2, VPC, EBS, RDS,
The console's region menu says "Global" for global ones.
